jobs.title: Software and Satellite Operations Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.desc: We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Quality Engineer to join our Mission Assurance team. This role sits at the intersection where software quality meets in-orbit operations, offering the opportunity to drive the operational performance of a satellite constellation. The role has two facets, you will own software quality assurance activities across the development lifecycle and also provide quality oversight to the team operating our constellation of satellites during commissioning, operations, and anomaly response. As the company implements its development roadmap, the distinction between these two aspects will blur with satellite operations increasingly transitioning to automated AI/ML tools to manage the fleet. The ideal candidate combines a rigorous, process-driven approach to software quality with an analytical mindset and operational awareness to allow them to ensure on-orbit anomalies are investigated and resolved effectively. This is a broad remit, so previous experience in both areas is not required. For example, a strong software QA background in a demanding industry (e.g. banking, medical, defence) will likely also have developed the analytical mindset needed to investigate on orbit issues. You will work closely with a fantastic team of software engineers, systems engineers, technical experts and spacecraft operators to ensure that our software and satellites are fit for purpose and that deviations from expected behaviour are understood, reported, assessed, and resolved with sound engineering judgment. What You'll Do as Software Satellite Operations Quality Engineer: Software Quality Assurance (Primary Focus): Define and maintain software QA processes, standards, and acceptance criteria for onboard and ground segment software across the full development lifecycle. Ensure that software verification and validation activities are comprehensive and correctly executed. Ensure the Software Development Lifecycle meets applicable quality requirements and standards. Where situations require deviation from defined process, ensure that this is performed safely and in a controlled manner. Raise, track, and manage non-conformances, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are identified and implemented effectively. Ensure risks are identified, evaluated and communicated effectively to the project and management team. Ensure that the software configuration baseline is maintained throughout development and mission lifetimes. Confirm all software releases are reviewed and compliant to standards. Contribute to process improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with applicable standards (e.g. ISO 29110, ECSS-Q-ST-80, ECSS-E-ST-40, or equivalent). Satellite Operations (SatOps) Anomaly Support: Provide Mission Assurance support to satellite operations, especially during critical mission phases such as Checkout and Commissioning, In-Orbit Verification and anomaly response. Lead and contribute to anomaly investigations, root cause analyses, and failure review boards, ensuring findings are well-documented and lessons are captured. Ensure the mission impact of anomalies is assessed and operational workarounds, corrective actions and recovery steps are appropriate. Identify links between incidents and coordinate response to common anomalies across the fleet. Ensure lessons learned are fed back to satellite development teams using non-conformance and corrective action processes. Liaise with software development, systems engineering and satellite operations teams to continually improve satellite operations tooling, improving Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR), increasing automation and raising the availability of the satellite fleet through transition to AI/ML based systems. Serve as the mission assurance interface to the operations team, software engineers, and systems engineers during anomaly investigations and resolution. Basic Qualifications: BSc or MEng in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 3+ years of experience in a software QA, systems engineering, or mission assurance role within a highly regulated industry (e.g. aerospace, defence, banking, medical). Proven track record of contributing to investigations and fault finding of complex systems. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git) and issue tracking tools. Understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile and/or waterfall) and associated QA activities. Clear and concise communicator, able to present technical findings to diverse audiences including management and non-specialist stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working with FMEA, FDIR, hazard analysis, or other dependability and safety analysis methods. Experience with satellite operations or ground segment software in an operational environment. Experience supporting LEOP, commissioning, or in-orbit validation activities. Proficiency in scripting or data analysis for telemetry analysis. Background in configuration management in a regulated engineering environment. Experience with failure review boards or anomaly resolution in an operational setting. Knowledge of relevant standards such as ISO 29110, ECSS-Q-ST-80, ECSS-E-ST-40, or DO-178C. Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office. Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1 Global Perks 🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP) 🚀 Launch Attendance 🌴 Generous Time Off Policy 🎓 Education Assistance Program 🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 👣 Family Leave 💪 Fitness Reimbursement 🧡 Employee Referral Program 🍉 Healthy snacks beverages in every office About Spire We improve life on Earth with data from space. Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.
